parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} that this radio is currently operating on.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: This Channel number in the Operating Class that this Radio is currently operating on.

parameters.name: TxPower
parameters.description: Nominal Transmit Power EIRP that this radio is currently using for the current Channel in the Opeating Class. Represented as 2's complement signed integer in units of decibels relative to 1 mW ({{units}}).

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this group was collected.

object.description: Describes one of the current Operating Classes in use by this Radio. One Opeating Class is indicated for each current Operating Channel Bandwidth. The Channel indicated for the 20 MHz Operating Class is equal to the current primary channel.
